blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们系统地调查了物理递减自我改进的机制,缩放行为,和概括. 我们引入了 PhysRSI-eval ,通过五轴度量法量化物理 RSI: 初试性能,效率,成功率,预算及改进从失败. 在固定互动预算下,对18项操纵任务评价了不同的VLM. 对实验结果的分析激发了物理巴雷尔假说:不同的能力可能制约不同部分的改进. 五轴度量衡还区分了公共基准平均值接近的系统,并显示高分无需提前或高效率地获得收益. 我们从两个角度研究观测尺度:从公共能力中预测VLM剂的相对性能,从早期物理反馈中预测后来的进展. 这些分析加在一起,会问一个代理人能有多快和多远改进。 此外,我们进行工作空间干预,然后分析所遗留的改进。 消除历史会减少后期的成功,被冻结的工作空间在不为人知的布局上仍然有用,三个交叉任务案例更早成功. 结果表明,针对具体地点的适应和可重复使用的经验可以共存。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Frontier LLM agents demonstrate remarkable capabilities in directly generating actions for robotic manipulation.
Through iterative trial and error, they continually improve manipulation ability by updating skills, generating code, and using tools. [ 22 , 9 ] We call this process physical recursive self-improvement, or physical RSI.
In this work, rather than further demonstrating the impressive capabilities of frontier LLM agents, we pose three more fundamental questions: What is the origin of physical RSI capabilities? What scaling laws govern this process? Do the resulting improvements reflect overfitting or generalization?
blocks.zh:
边疆LLM代理显示在直接生成机器人操纵动作方面能力显著.
通过反复试验和错误,它们通过更新技能、生成代码和使用工具不断提高操纵能力。 [22,9]我们称这个过程为物理递归自我改进,或物理RSI.
在这项工作中,我们不但没有进一步展示边境LLM人员令人印象深刻的能力,反而提出了三个更根本的问题: 物质RSI能力的来源是什么? 这一进程由何种规模法管辖? 由此产生的改进是反映过度适应还是概括?

blocks.en: What allows an agent to turn physical feedback into a better policy? Perception helps it interpret outcomes, spatial reasoning relates observations to actions [ 31 ] , and coding and harness use allow it to implement and test revisions. These capabilities may play different roles. We ask whether strengths behind a good first attempt also explain improvement after feedback.
blocks.zh: 是什么允许代理人将物理反馈转化为更好的政策? 观念有助于解释结果,空间推理将观测与行动[31]相关,编码和利用使其得以实施和测试修订。 这些能力可能发挥不同的作用。 我们问,第一次良好尝试背后的优势是否也解释了反馈后的改进。

blocks.en: We introduce PhysRSI-eval to study these questions under a common protocol ( Figure 2 ). Six systems revise persistent code, tools and notes across 18 manipulation tasks, with frozen model weights and a fixed physical interaction budget. Gemini 4 is reported separately on ten tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍PhysRSI-eval根据共同议定书研究这些问题(图2)。 6个系统在18项操纵任务中修改了持久性代码,工具和注释,并有冻结的模型权重和固定的物理交互预算. 双子座4号单独报告十项任务.

blocks.en: An exploratory comparison of four public capability profiles on the 18 tasks associates spatial reasoning most strongly with initial performance, and perception with attained performance and recovery ( Figure 4 ). This pattern motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis : the capability that limits an agent may depend on which aspect of improvement we measure. Starting well and learning from failure may require different strengths. These associations suggest candidate bottlenecks, not causal requirements.
blocks.zh: 对18项任务的4项公共能力简介进行探索性比较,将空间推理与初始性能和已实现性能和恢复的感知关系最为密切(图4)。 这种模式激发了物理巴雷尔假说:限制一种剂的能力可能取决于我们衡量改进的哪个方面。 从失败中汲取教训需要不同的长处。 这些协会提出了候选瓶颈,而不是因果要求。

blocks.en: An endpoint score alone cannot quantify physical RSI. It says little about when gains occur or what they cost. Repeated attempts can also increase the chance of success without useful revision. Our five-axis metric separates initial performance, gain timing, attained score, physical budget savings and recovery from failure ( Section 3.4 ). These axes reveal different strengths. Opus 5.5 attains a higher score than GPT-6.1 Sol, but has lower gain-timing and budget-savings scores. Higher scores need not mean improving earlier or using fewer physical interactions.
blocks.zh: 单凭一个终点分数无法量化物理 RSI 。 它很少提到收益何时出现或成本。 反复尝试也可以增加成功的机会,而不作有益的修改。 我们的五轴衡量标准将初步业绩、获得时间、达到分数、实际节省预算以及从失败中回收(第3.4节)。 这些轴揭示了不同的长处. Opus 5.5的得分比GPT-6.1 Sol更高,但收益率和预算节省的得分较低. 较高的分数不一定意味着更早的改善或使用较少的物理互动.

blocks.en: With these outcomes defined, we study observational scaling across model capabilities and physical interaction budgets. Following Ruan et al. [34] , we first ask whether public capability scores can predict the relative order of held-out systems, in attained performance and gain timing ( Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 通过确定这些成果,我们研究跨模型能力的观测规模和实际互动预算。 在Ruan et al.[34]之后,我们首先问公共能力分数是否能够预测在达到性能和获得时间方面被搁置系统的相对顺序(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: We then ask whether early physical progress predicts the gains from a larger interaction budget. This connects physical RSI to the study of learning curves [ 19 , 12 ] , with the interaction round as our budget variable. Calibrating the improvement shape of a reference model to a few early rounds forecasts the rest of a related model’s trajectory ( Figure 8 ). The two analyses address complementary questions: what improvement to expect from a model’s capabilities, and how much further it may progress after its first attempts. Both remain exploratory.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们问早期的实际进展是否预测了更大的互动预算的收益。 这将物理 RSI 与学习曲线的研究[19, 12] 联系起来, 交互回合作为我们的预算变量. 将参考模型的改进形状校准到几发早期的子弹,预测了相关模型的其余轨迹(图8)。 这两项分析涉及补充性问题:预期模型的能力会有什么改进,在最初尝试之后还可以取得多大进展。 两者都是探索性的。

blocks.en: Does the agent acquire a reusable procedure, or adapt to its practice scene? A rising score alone cannot answer this question. We first remove history to test whether retained experience helps beyond repeated attempts. We then freeze workspaces on unseen layouts and transfer them across tasks.
blocks.zh: 该代理人是获得可重复使用的程序,还是适应其实践场景? 单靠提高得分无法回答这个问题。 我们首先去掉历史,以检验保留的经验是否有助于超越反复尝试. 然后在看不见的布局上冻结工作空间,并在任务之间转移。

blocks.en: In a six-task Astra ablation, removing history lowers late-round success from 41.7% to 8.3% ( Table 8 ). With further revision disabled, frozen workspace files support success in 25 of 60 trials on unseen layouts ( Table 9 ). Three cross-task cases also reach first success earlier when initialized from other tasks’ workspaces ( Figure 9 ). These results support a role for retained experience and show that some artifacts remain useful beyond the scenes where they were refined. Scene-specific gains and useful transfer can coexist. Explaining which retained skills or memories enable transfer connects this question back to the origins of physical RSI.
blocks.zh: 在六大任务中,消除历史将晚期成功率从41.7%降至8.3%(表8)。 由于进一步的修改被禁用,冻结的工作空间文件支持了在60次试验中的25次在无形布局上取得成功(表9)。 三个跨任务案件在从其他任务的工作空间初始化时也提前取得了第一个成功(图9)。 这些成果支持保留经验的作用,并表明一些文物在经过精炼的场景之外仍然有用。 场景特定收益和有用的转移可以共存. 解释哪些保留技能或记忆能够使转移能够将这个问题与物理RSI的起源联系起来.

blocks.en: Our contributions follow this progression: • Five-axis evaluation and capability diagnosis. A fixed-budget protocol separates five physical RSI outcomes and relates them to four capability profiles, motivating the Physical Barrel Hypothesis. • Observational scaling and prediction. Cross-model rank prediction and early-round forecasting probe how model capabilities and interaction budget relate to physical improvement. • Specialization and generalization. Ablations, frozen-workspace tests and cross-task adaptation examine whether gains depend on retained experience and whether that experience remains useful elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是随着这一进展而来的:五轴评价和能力诊断。 一项固定预算协议将五个实际的RSI结果分开,并将其与四个能力剖面联系起来,从而激发了物理巴雷尔假设。 • 观测规模和预测。 跨模型排位预测和早期周期预测探险 模型能力和相互作用预算如何与物理改进相关. • 专门化和一般化。 减员、冷冻工作空间测试和跨任务调整审查收益是否取决于保留的经验,以及这种经验是否在其他地方仍然有用。

blocks.en: Five-axis evaluation and capability diagnosis. A fixed-budget protocol separates five physical RSI outcomes and relates them to four capability profiles, motivating the Physical Barrel Hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 五轴评价与能力诊断. 一项固定预算协议将五个实际的RSI结果分开,并将其与四个能力剖面联系起来,从而激发了物理巴雷尔假设。

blocks.en: Observational scaling and prediction. Cross-model rank prediction and early-round forecasting probe how model capabilities and interaction budget relate to physical improvement.
blocks.zh: 观测尺度和预测。 跨模型排位预测和早期周期预测探险 模型能力和相互作用预算如何与物理改进相关.

blocks.en: Specialization and generalization. Ablations, frozen-workspace tests and cross-task adaptation examine whether gains depend on retained experience and whether that experience remains useful elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 专修通论. 减员、冷冻工作空间测试和跨任务调整审查收益是否取决于保留的经验,以及这种经验是否在其他地方仍然有用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM-as-policy Agents and Embodied Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 LLM -- -- 政策代理人和健全评价

blocks.en: LLMs can act as robot policies by writing programs over perception and control tools [ 22 ] . Feedback lets them revise plans or reward code [ 39 , 14 , 26 ] . Recent benchmarks evaluate these policies through controlled robot interfaces [ 7 , 24 , 5 , 57 , 52 ] , while others give coding agents extended simulator access and assess the resulting programs [ 35 , 25 ] . These evaluations typically summarize outcomes per episode, across independent trials or within a time budget. A reported Astra case, where a self-written fix succeeded once and failed on repetition, highlights the gap between finding a solution and retaining reliable behavior [ 9 ] . PhysRSI-eval tracks judged physical attempts connected by a persistent workspace, measuring both progress and physical cost under a fixed budget.
blocks.zh: LLMS可以通过写程序凌驾于感知和控制工具之上来发挥机器人政策的作用[22]. 反馈让他们修改计划或奖励守则[39、14、26]。 最近的基准通过受控制的机器人界面[7,24,5,57,52]来评价这些政策,而其他基准则给予编码代理扩展模拟器访问,并评估由此产生的程序[35,25]. 这些评价通常总结每个事件、独立审判或时间预算的结果。 一个报道的Astra案件,一个自写定律成功一次,重复一次失败,凸显了寻找解决方案和保留可靠行为之间的差距[9]. PhysRSI-eval轨道判断了由持续工作空间连接的物理尝试,在固定预算下测量进度和物理成本.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agent Self-Improvement
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理人自我改进

blocks.en: Agents can accumulate skills and reflections without updating their model weights [ 43 , 37 , 27 ] . Recent benchmarks examine whether changes to the harness or retained experience improve later performance [ 13 , 46 , 38 , 58 ] . Producing an update and benefiting from it are distinct questions [ 23 ] . Related designs test memory, transfer and gains relative to cost [ 36 , 49 , 10 , 17 , 20 , 47 ] . AI-R&D benchmarks address research engineering under time or compute budgets [ 45 , 1 , 40 , 32 , 4 ] . These designs motivate separating initial ability, improvement and cost, and testing retained experience against repeated attempts. PhysRSI-eval brings these questions to physical interaction. Native task scores evaluate each attempt, while workspace interventions test what the agent retains. Clearing the workspace tests whether accumulated experience helps; freezing and transferring it test whether its benefits extend to new layouts and tasks.
blocks.zh: 代理人可以积累技能和反射,而不更新他们的模型重量[43,37,27]. 最近的基准审查对利用方式的改变或保留的经验是否改善了以后的业绩[13、46、38、58]。 提供最新情况并从中获益是不同的问题。 相关设计测试内存,转移和收益相对于成本[36,49,10,17,20,47]. AI-R&D基准在时间或计算预算中涉及研究工程[45、1、40、32、4]。 这些设计促使将初始能力、改进和成本区分开来,使经验与反复尝试相抗衡。 PhysRSI-eval将这些问题引入物理交互. 原生任务分数评价每次尝试,而工作空间干预则测试代理人保留什么. 清除工作空间测试是否有助于积累经验;冻结和转移测试其好处是否延伸到新的布局和任务。

blocks.en: 2.3 Capability Benchmarks and Observational Scaling
blocks.zh: 2.3 能力基准和观测尺度

blocks.en: Public benchmarks provide candidate measures of perception [ 8 , 54 , 33 ] , spatial reasoning [ 2 , 50 , 6 , 16 ] , coding and tool use [ 18 , 44 , 15 , 28 , 48 , 53 ] , and broader reasoning and work performance [ 30 , 42 , 29 ] . Embodied benchmarks and VLA models address planning and physical reasoning [ 51 , 21 , 11 , 56 , 41 ] , but do not track policy revision from graded attempts. Observational scaling relates benchmark-derived capability factors to agent performance across models [ 34 ] . We predict the relative order of physical improvement, in both extent and timing, from public scores. We also forecast later gains from early physical performance. With few closed systems and no training-compute data, these analyses remain observational and exploratory.
blocks.zh: 公共基准提供了可选的感知尺度[8,54,33],空间推理[2,50,6,16],编码和工具使用[18,44,15,28,48,53],以及更广泛的推理和工作表现[30,42,29]. 健全的基准和甚低层次分析模型涉及规划和物理推理[51、21、11、56、41],但没有跟踪从分级尝试中修改政策的情况。 观测尺度将基准能力系数与各种模型的代理性能联系起来[34]。 我们预测,从公共评分来看,身体的改善在程度和时间上都是相对的。 我们还预测,早期身体表现以后会有所收获。 由于封闭的系统很少,而且没有训练计算数据,这些分析仍然是观察和探索性的。

blocks.en: 3 PhysRSI-eval: Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 3 PhysRSI - eval: (英语). 基准设计

blocks.en: PhysRSI-eval makes the three questions measurable by recording both physical attempts and the workspace carried between them. The attempt sequence reveals where an agent starts and how it progresses under a fixed budget. Workspace interventions test what agents retain and whether it transfers.
blocks.zh: PhysRSI-eval通过记录物理尝试和它们之间的工作空间,使三个问题可以衡量. 尝试序列揭示了代理人的起始地点和在固定预算下如何发展. 工作空间干预测试哪些物剂保留,是否转移。

blocks.en: 3.1 What Must the Benchmark Distinguish?
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准必须区分什么?

blocks.en: A strong first attempt and useful revision are different abilities. We therefore score a first-attempt baseline separately and follow subsequent attempts under a fixed budget. Per-round scores show when gains occur; charged physical steps show what they cost. Reaching a high score, reaching it early and using fewer interactions are separate outcomes.
blocks.zh: 有力的第一次尝试和有益的修订是不同的能力。 因此,我们分别确定一个先行的基线,并跟踪随后在固定预算下进行的尝试。 每轮得分显示收益发生时;计费物理步骤显示其成本. 达到高分,提前达到和少用互动是单独的结果.

blocks.en: Success alone does not show whether the agent has accumulated useful experience. Code, tools and notes must remain accessible for intervention. Clearing the workspace tests whether retained experience helps; freezing it on unseen layouts tests whether it remains useful; transferring it to new tasks tests whether it can support a different goal. We report these tests separately from the main profiles in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 仅靠成功并不能表明代理人是否积累了有益的经验。 守则、工具和说明必须保持可供干预。 清除工作空间测试是否有助于保存经验; 在看不见的布局上将其冻结测试是否仍然有用; 将其转移到新的任务测试中, 测试是否能够支持不同的目标 。 我们从第6节的主要简介中单独报告这些测试。

blocks.en: 3.2 A Controlled Loop of Physical Attempts
blocks.zh: 3.2 控制下的身体尝试循环

blocks.en: Model weights stay fixed, while skills, tools, policy code and memory can change in a persistent workspace. Each revision is tested through a judged physical attempt ( Figure 2 ). This connects workspace changes to an observed outcome and a physical cost.
blocks.zh: 模型权重保持不变,而技能,工具,政策代码和内存可以在持续的工作空间中改变. 每次修订都通过判断的物理尝试进行测试(图2)。 这把工作空间的改变与观察到的结果和实物成本联系起来。

blocks.en: K0 measures the starting point without a persistent workspace. Each task runs three times through the shared robot tools, and its scores are averaged. At K1, the agent receives a Harness workspace that is empty except for the host’s read-only tools. Each round executes one physical attempt and returns the native score, success flag and failure reason. The agent then revises its workspace with robot actions disabled and commits it for the next round. The main evaluation allows at most H = 17 H=17 refinement rounds per task and stops at the first native success.
blocks.zh: K0 测量没有持续工作空间的起点. 每个任务通过共享的机器人工具运行三次,其得分平均. 在 K1 时, 代理接收一个空的 Harness 工作空间, 除了主机的只读工具之外 。 每回合执行一次物理尝试并返回原生分数,成功旗帜和失败原因. 代理机随后修改其工作空间,将机器人动作禁用,并投入下一轮. 主评价最多允许H=17H=17次每任务改进回合,并在首次本土成功时停止.

blocks.en: Both stages share the robot interface. K1 also introduces workspace tools and program execution, so the K0-to-K1 gain mixes interface changes with improvement. We therefore study the Harness rounds as the self-improvement segment. Each round allows 4200 s of reasoning; revision takes up to 1800 s for GPT systems and 600 s for Claude systems ( Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 两个阶段都共享机器人界面. K1还引入了工作空间工具和程序执行,因此K0对K1的增益会随着改进而混合接口变化. 因此,我们研究哈尼斯回合作为自我改进部分。 每轮允许4200 s的推理;修改时GPT系统需要高达1800 s,克劳德系统需要600 s(表3 ).

blocks.en: For aggregation, successful tasks retain score 1 after stopping, without further execution. Unsuccessful tasks retain their current scores, including regressions. Extra attempts enter the physical budget but add no scoring rounds. Nine GPT-5.6 Sol Harness entries summarize two observed runs. The three-repeat K0 protocol applies to all six systems.
blocks.zh: 对于汇总,成功的任务在停止后保留积分1,不再执行. 未成功的任务保留其目前的分数,包括回归. 额外尝试输入物理预算, 但不添加计分回合 。 9个GPT-5.6 Sol Harness条目总结了两个观察到的运行. 三重奏K0协议适用于所有六个系统.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Two stages, one interface. Top: the task input and robot interface shared by both stages (observations, physical actions, memory and files, history). Left, Evaluate (first-attempt round K0): one in-context episode of observe–reason–act through the shared tools, with no workspace; history and notes stay inside the episode. Right, Optimize (self-improvement rounds K1–K H H ): each round runs from a persistent workspace of skills, tools, policy and memory, is graded natively, revised with robot actions closed, and committed as the start of the next round, until the first native success or the round limit.
blocks.zh: 图2:两个阶段,一个接口. Top:两个阶段(观察,物理动作,内存和文件,历史)共享的任务输入和机器人接口. 左边 评估(第一尝试回合K0):通过共享工具进行观察-理性-行动的一集内文,没有工作空间;历史和笔记留在该集内。 右,优化(自改进回合K1–K H ):每回合从技能,工具,政策和记忆的持久工作空间出发,在本土进行分级,通过机器人动作关闭进行修改,承诺作为下一轮的开始,直到首次本土成功或回合限制.

blocks.en: 3.3 Tasks across Difficulty Levels
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 跨难度级的任务

blocks.en: The task suite must expose both immediate competence and room for improvement. We evaluate the loop on 18 RoboDojo dual-arm manipulation tasks. They cover language-conditioned arrangement, stacking, container placement, insertion, pouring, pushing and dynamic picking ( Figures 3 and 2 ). The suite spans RoboDojo’s five official task categories (Precision, Long-Horizon, Memory, Open and Generalization) and samples three tasks from each of six difficulty strata. The strata are assigned from the official RoboDojo success rates [ 3 ] : the 18 tasks are ranked by success rate and grouped three per stratum, from D1 (success rate 60–68.7%) to D6 (success rate 0–0.4%). This balances coverage across difficulty levels. The strata are fixed before the main evaluation and are not derived from our refinement outcomes. All 18 tasks, including object packing, receive equal weight. Each retains its native score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , success criterion and step limit of 300–1300 steps at 25 Hz. The main evaluation uses layout 0 and seed 0. Partial scores expose progress before the first success.
blocks.zh: 任务组合必须同时暴露出即时能力和改进的余地。 我们评估了 18项机械兵双臂操纵任务 它们包括语言条件安排、堆放、集装箱放置、插入、浇灌、推压和动态采摘(图3和图2)。 套间横跨RoboDojo的五个正式任务类别(精密、长视野、记忆、开放和通用), 从官方的RoboDojo成功率分配等级 [3]: 18项任务按成功率排列,从D1(成功率60-68.7%)到D6(成功率0-0.4%),每层分为三个。 这平衡了困难程度的覆盖面。 等级在主要评价之前是固定的,不是从我们的改进结果中得出的。 所有18项任务,包括物品包装,都得到同等重量。 每个都保留其本土得分[0,1][0,1],成功标准和步限300–1300步以25赫兹. 主评价采用布局0和种子0. 部分分数显示在第一次成功之前取得了进展。

Three tasks per difficulty stratum, from D1 (highest official RoboDojo success rate) to D6 (lowest), covering RoboDojo’s five official task categories. Strata are assigned by ranking the tasks on the official RoboDojo success rate [ 3 ] and are fixed before the main evaluation; they do not describe the subsequent refinement outcomes.

blocks.en: We evaluate six systems: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5. Each system comprises a model and its runtime configuration, which can also affect performance ( Table 3 ). In a separate experiment without supplementary hints, Astra solves 13 tasks, compared with 15 in the main evaluation. Results from these conditions are reported separately.
blocks.zh: 我们评价六个系统:GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Sol、GPT-5.6 Sol、 克劳德·奥普斯·5.5和克劳德·索内·5.5. 每个系统都包含一个模型及其运行时间配置,这也可能影响性能(表3). 在没有补充提示的单独实验中,Astra解决了13项任务,而主评价中有15项. 这些情况的结果另行报告。

blocks.en: Gemini 4 is reported in a separate partial run covering ten tasks through K20, with six solved. Its reported mean scores are 0.050 at K0 and 0.48 at K10. Its five-axis profile is computed on these ten tasks ( Tables 1 and 5 ). Because the task set differs from the main 18-task protocol, it is excluded from the benchmark-based association and prediction analyses.
blocks.zh: 双子座4号被单独报告为部分运行,覆盖了通过K20的10项任务,其中6项已解决. 其报告的平均分是K0为0.050分,K10为0.48分. 它的五轴轮廓是根据这10项任务计算的(表1和表5)。 由于任务集与主要18任务协议不同,它被排除在基于基准的关联和预测分析之外.

blocks.en: 4 Where is Physical RSI capability from?
blocks.zh: 页:1 RSI的物理能力从何而来?

blocks.en: What allows physical feedback to become a useful policy revision? Acting, interpreting an outcome and implementing a change may draw on different capabilities. We use the five-axis profile to ask whether the capabilities associated with a strong first attempt also track effective improvement.
blocks.zh: 是什么使物理反馈成为有用的政策修订? 行动、解释结果和执行变革可能利用不同的能力。 我们用五轴剖面图来询问,与第一次强烈尝试有关的能力是否也跟踪有效的改进。

blocks.en: 4.1 Which Capabilities Track Physical RSI?
blocks.zh: 4.1 哪些能力 追踪物理 RSI?

blocks.en: Strong coding scores alone do not ensure physical improvement. GPT-5.6 Sol exceeds GPT-6 Astra on LiveBench code generation and completion, yet solves one of the 18 tasks, whereas Astra solves 15.
blocks.zh: 单靠强大的编码分数并不能保证物理上的改善. GPT-5.6 Sol在LiveBench代码生成和完成上超过了GPT-6 Astra,然而解决了18项任务之一,而Astra解决了15项.

blocks.en: 4.2 The Physical Barrel Hypothesis
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 物理巴雷尔假说

blocks.en: The pattern motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis : different aspects of improvement may have different capability bottlenecks. Spatial reasoning may matter most for starting well, while perception may matter more for interpreting failures and recovering from them. Under this hypothesis, strong coding cannot always compensate for a weakness elsewhere. Its weak associations do not imply that coding is unnecessary; all systems use code here.
blocks.zh: 这种模式激发了物理巴雷尔假说:改进的不同方面可能具有不同的能力瓶颈。 空间推理对于良好的开端可能最为重要,而感知对于解释失败和从失败中恢复则更为重要。 根据这一假设,强编码不能总是弥补其他地方的弱点. 它的弱关联并不意味着编码是不必要的;所有系统都在这里使用代码.

blocks.en: These associations identify candidate bottlenecks that targeted capability interventions can test directly ( Section 12 ).
blocks.zh: 这些协会查明了可直接检验有针对性的能力干预措施的候选瓶颈(第12节)。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Capability associations and the barrel hypothesis. The matrix reports exploratory rank associations across six systems on the 18 tasks. Each barrel represents one RSI axis, with a stave per capability group. Stave heights illustrate a proposed bottleneck interpretation of the associations.
blocks.zh: 图4:能力关联和枪管假设。 该矩阵报告在18项任务方面对6个系统的协会进行了探索性排名。 每个枪管代表一个RSI轴,每个能力组各有一个隔板. 僵持的高度说明了对协会提出的瓶颈解释。

blocks.en: These candidate bottlenecks lead to the second question: how can we quantify physical RSI and its scaling with model capabilities and interaction budget?
blocks.zh: 这些候选瓶颈导致第二个问题:我们如何用模型能力和互动预算来量化实际的衡量标准?

blocks.en: 5 How can we quantify Physical RSI and its scaling law?
blocks.zh: 页:1 我们如何量化物理RSI及其缩放定律?

blocks.en: How much can an agent improve, when do its main gains occur, and how much interaction does it need? The five-axis profile turns these questions into measurable outcomes. We first quantify differences among agents, then study how these outcomes scale with model capabilities and physical interaction budget.
blocks.zh: 一个代理人能改进多少,何时产生其主要收益,需要多少互动? 五轴剖面将这些问题转化为可衡量的结果。 我们首先量化各行为体之间的差异,然后研究这些成果如何以模型能力和物理互动预算来衡量。

blocks.en: 5.1 High Scores, Fast Gains and Low Cost Can Diverge
blocks.zh: 5.1 高分、快速收益和低成本可变

blocks.en: Opus has a higher Success score than GPT-6.1 Sol (0.744 versus 0.703), but lower Efficiency (0.609 versus 0.822). On each system’s solved tasks, Opus saves less of the budget (0.579 versus 0.808), and the gap persists on the ten tasks both systems solve. Higher attained scores can come with later gains and greater physical costs ( Tables 1 and 5 ).
blocks.zh: 奥普斯的成功分数高于GPT-6.1 Sol(0.744对0.703),但效率较低(0.609对0.822)。 在每一个系统解决的任务上,奥普斯节省的预算较少(0.579比0.808),两个系统解决的十项任务上的差距仍然存在. 更高的得分可带来以后的收益和实际成本更高(表1和表5)。

blocks.en: Across the six systems, task-mean scores rise from 0.01–0.37 at K0 to 0.10–0.84 by the end of evaluation. They solve 15, 12, 7, 1, 13 and 11 of 18 tasks, respectively: Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Sol, Opus and Sonnet. Astra leads on all five axes. The two Claude systems pair relatively high attained scores with middling gain timing, while the GPT Sol family spans a much wider range. GPT-5.6 Sol remains low on Success and Improvement; its Budget score is conditional on one solved task. The profile exposes these trade-offs without a single ranking.
blocks.zh: 在六个系统中,任务平均得分从0.01-0.37K0上升到评价结束时的0.10-0.84。 他们分别解决了18项任务中的15,12,7,1,13和11项:Astra,GPT-6.1 Sol,GPT-6 Sol,GPT-5.6 Sol,Opus和Sonnet. 阿斯特拉带领所有五轴. 两个克劳德系统配对的成绩相对较高,而且相互干扰的得分也越来越高,而GPT Sol家族则跨度更广。 GPT-5.6 Sol在成功和改进方面仍然很低;其预算得分取决于一项已解决的任务。 简介揭露这些权衡,没有单列排名.

blocks.en: How much do public benchmark averages reveal about these differences? Across the four GPT systems, mean scores over 17 public benchmarks span 54.1–78.1, while the equally weighted physical profile mean, 100 × ∑ j = 1 5 A j / 5 100\times\sum_{j=1}^{5}A_{j}/5 , spans 13.9–73.4 ( Figure 6 ). The ranges are 24 and 59.5 points on different scales. GPT-5.6 Sol stays near zero cumulative success for 16 rounds: more attempts do not close every capability gap within this budget.

The Physical Barrel Hypothesis offers one explanation. Useful improvement may require a minimum level of a needed capability, even when other capabilities are strong. The rapid contraction region in Figure 6 illustrates this threshold hypothesis and motivates predicting physical outcomes from capability profiles rather than a public benchmark average.
blocks.zh: 物理巴雷尔假说给出了一个解释. 有益的改进可能需要最低限度的必要能力,即使其他能力很强。 图6中的快速收缩区域说明了这一阈值假设,并激励人们从能力剖面而非公共基准平均值中预测实际结果。

blocks.en: 5.2 Observational Scaling across Model Capabilities
blocks.zh: 5.2 跨模型能力的观测放大

blocks.en: Can public capability scores anticipate physical improvement before the full evaluation is run? This is the cross-model question of observational scaling. Beyond correlating capabilities with outcomes, a predictor must place an unseen system using only the relationships observed in other systems.
blocks.zh: 公共能力评分在全面评价进行之前能否预期到实际改善? 这就是观测尺度的跨模型问题。 除了将能力与结果联系起来之外,预测器还必须设置一个仅使用其他系统中观察到的关系的看不见的系统。

blocks.en: 5.3 What Can Early Physical Feedback Predict?
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 我们能做什么? 早期物理反馈预测?

blocks.en: These analyses address the amount and timing of improvement. We next ask what the gains represent: adaptation to the refinement setting, or experience that remains useful elsewhere?
blocks.zh: 这些分析涉及改进的数量和时间。 我们接下来要问的是,这些成就意味着什么:适应完善的设定,还是其他地方仍然有用的经验?

blocks.en: 6 Does Physical RSI reflect overfitting or generalization?
blocks.zh: 6 实际 RSI反映了过度适应还是概括?

blocks.en: With fixed model weights, generalization concerns the code, tools and notes the agent retains. Do they encode reusable procedures, or do they become specialized to the refinement setting? We first test whether retained experience helps beyond repeated attempts. We then evaluate frozen workspaces on unseen layouts and transfer them to new tasks.
blocks.zh: 有了固定的模型权重,概括化涉及代理所保留的代码,工具和注释. 它们是编码可重复使用的程序,还是专门用于改进设置? 我们首先检验保留的经验是否有助于超越反复尝试。 然后,我们评估冷冻的工作空间 在看不见的布局,并把它们转移到新的任务。

Bottom: trajectories initialized from a workspace pooled from all other tasks, excluding the target task. First success advances from K9 to K1 for Sonnet 5.5 on Cover Blocks, from K14 to K7 for Opus 5.5 on Organize Table, and from K15 to K8 for Opus 5.5 on Deposit Coin. These examples illustrate faster adaptation with transferred workspaces. Red crosses indicate unsuccessful attempts, dark checks mark first success, and pale checks carry success forward without additional evaluation.

blocks.en: 6.1 Does Retained Experience Help Beyond Repeated Attempts?
blocks.zh: 6.1 保留经验是否有助于超越重复尝试?

blocks.en: The Astra ablation varies which information from earlier rounds reaches the agent: the workspace, grader feedback, images and action records ( Table 7 ). It covers six tasks with two chains each; layouts change every round over K1–K6, and execution continues after success. The full loop keeps all four channels, whereas the no-history condition keeps none, so its six rounds are independent attempts. Late-round success over K4–K6 is 15/36 (41.7%) for the full loop and 3/36 (8.3%) without history ( Table 8 ). This supports a role for accumulated information under this protocol.
blocks.zh: Astra 衰减因较早的回合而不同: 工作空间、 分级反馈、 图像和动作记录(表 7) 。 它包括六个任务,每个任务有两个链;布局在K1–K6上每轮变化,成功后继续执行. 全环保持所有四个频道,而无历史条件则保持无,因此其六轮是独立的尝试. K4–K6的较晚周期成功率为15/36(41.7%)全循环,3/36(8.3%)无历史记录(表8)。 这有助于在本议定书之下积累信息。

blocks.en: The remaining conditions withhold individual channels. Withholding grader feedback causes the largest drop, to 5/36 (13.9%), and withholding earlier-round images yields 12/36 (33.3%). Keeping only the workspace and grader feedback yields 17/36 (47.2%), so past images and action records add little once these two channels are kept. The no-history control supports a role for retained experience, but leaves open whether that experience is specific to the refinement setting.
blocks.zh: 其余条件限制了个别渠道。 没有分级器的反馈造成最大的下降,降至5/36(13.9%),而预留的图像则达到12/36(33.3%)。 只保留工作空间和分级器反馈值为17/36(47.2%),因此,一旦保留这两个信道,过去的图像和动作记录就没有什么增加。 无历史控制支持保留经验的作用,但对于这种经验是否与完善设定具体有关,则不作定论。

blocks.en: 6.2 What Survives When Revision Stops?
blocks.zh: 6.2 审校停止时有何幸存?

blocks.en: To test whether the stored artifacts work beyond practice, we freeze Astra workspaces after K6 and test each on five unseen layouts, with no further revision or outcome feedback ( Table 9 ). Across 12 sources, workspace files alone succeed in 25/60 tests (41.7%). Adding prior raw records gives 23/60 (38.3%). The stored artifacts remain useful under layout changes, while these point estimates show no benefit from exposing the raw history at test time.
blocks.zh: 为了检验所储存的文物是否在实践之外工作,我们将K6之后的Astra工作空间冻结,并按5个看不见的布局进行测试,没有进一步的修改或结果反馈(表9). 在12个来源中,仅工作空间文件就成功进行了25/60测试(41.7%)。 增加以前的原始记录为23/60(38.3%)。 所储存的文物在布局变化下仍然有用,而这些点估计表明在试验时揭露原始历史没有任何好处。

blocks.en: Fixed-layout source workspaces reach 27/60 (45.0%) on held-out layouts, compared with the reported 14/16 (88%) on their own layout. The different denominators prevent a matched paired interpretation. Still, the comparison suggests that scene-specific gains and transferable experience can coexist. These tests establish some cross-scene usefulness for Astra on this task subset; they do not establish generalization across all systems.
blocks.zh: 固定排出源工作空间在被搁置布局上达到27/60(45.0%),而所报告的14/16(88%)则在其自身布局上达到. 不同的分母使配对解释无法进行。 然而,比较表明,具体地点的收益和可转移的经验可以共存。 这些测试为Astra这一任务子集提供了一些跨场的有用性;它们并没有在所有系统建立通用性。

blocks.en: 6.3 Can Experience Help on a Different Task?
blocks.zh: 6.3 经验可以帮助完成不同的任务吗?

blocks.en: Traces from five models suggest two forms of reusable experience: executable routines and textual operating knowledge. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 increasingly encode control in self-written tools, which generate over 96% of their actions in later rounds. GPT-6 Sol also builds a substantial tool library, but tools generate 67% of actions while the model generates 33% directly. These shares measure tool reliance.
blocks.zh: 5种模式的追踪建议了两种可重复使用的经验:可执行的常规和文字操作知识. Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5越来越多地在自写工具中编码控制,这些工具在以后的回合中产生96%以上的动作. GPT-6 常规 Sol还建立了一个实质性的工具库,但工具生成67%的动作,而模型直接生成33%. 这些共享工具的依赖度。

blocks.en: These tool libraries grow across rounds, combining tools created from scratch with those derived from earlier implementations. We use tool lineage to identify reuse across rounds. Direct use, modification and derivation of an existing tool all count as reuse. A directed relation A → B indicates that tool B is derived from tool A. Tracing these relations across rounds reveals how later tools build on earlier implementations. Among the three models with substantial tool libraries, Opus exhibits broader reuse and lower concentration. Its lineage reuse rate is 0.347, compared with 0.167 for Sonnet and 0.086 for GPT-6 Sol. The top 10% of reused lineages account for 48% of subsequent calls in Opus, compared with 76% in Sonnet and 83% in GPT-6 Sol. Together, these patterns suggest that Opus accumulates a broader reusable toolbox, while reuse in Sonnet and GPT-6 Sol remains concentrated in a smaller subset of tools ( Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh: 这些工具库分几轮发展,将零头创造的工具与早期实施过程中产生的工具结合起来。 我们使用工具线条来识别各个回合的再利用。 直接使用、修改和衍生现有工具均算作再利用。 直接关系A_B表示工具B来源于工具A. 在各个回合中追踪这些关系,可以发现后期工具如何以先前的实施为基础。 在具有大量工具库的三种模型中,Opus展出了更广泛的再利用和较低的浓度。 其世系再利用率为0.347,而Sonnet为0.167,GPT-6 Sol为0.086. 在Opus的复用线条中,前10%的复用线条占后来通话的48%,而Sonnet的复用线条占76%,GPT-6 Sol的复用线条占83%. 这些模式加在一起表明,Opus累积了一个更广泛的可重复使用的工具箱,而Sonnet和GPT-6 Sol中的重复使用仍然集中在一个较小的工具子集中(图10 )。

(b) Fraction of tool lineages reused in subsequent rounds, among those with later rounds available. Reuse includes direct use, modification and derivation of existing tools. (c) Reuse breadth, defined as one minus the share of subsequent calls accounted for by the top 10% of reused lineages. Higher values indicate reuse distributed across more lineages. Astra is omitted because it creates very few tools, used only for verification. GPT-6.1 Sol’s estimates reflect a small library of seven tools.

blocks.en: Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol follow a different pattern. Approximately 99% of their actions remain directly generated by the model. They use only a very small number of tools for verification, but their reasoning time decreases across rounds. File-access traces show repeated use of memory, skills and policy notes to recover successful actions and subtask solutions, diagnose failures and guide revisions. These observations suggest that both executable routines and retained operating knowledge can reduce repeated reasoning.
blocks.zh: 阿斯特拉和GPT-6.1 索尔遵循不同的模式. 大约99%的行动仍然由模型直接产生。 它们只使用极少数核查工具,但其推理时间逐轮减少。 文件访问记录显示反复使用内存,技能和政策说明来恢复成功的动作和子任务解决方案,诊断失败并指导修改. 这些意见表明,可执行的常规和保留操作知识都可以减少重复推理.

blocks.en: We further find that the workspace and generalization analyses align with the Physical RSI Barrel Hypothesis across its four capability factors: spatial reasoning, perception, coding and harness operation. Spatial tools account for 14.5% of Sonnet’s tool calls and 13.7% of Opus’s, with 408 of 2,819 calls and 183 of 1,332 calls, respectively. Astra makes only seven tool calls, including one to such a tool, or 14%. Astra’s minimal reliance on these modules suggests stronger intrinsic perceptual and spatial capabilities. Sonnet and Opus repeatedly reuse these modules across tasks, suggesting that they rely more on tools to compensate for limitations in these capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们还发现,工作空间和一般化分析与物理 RSI Barrel 假说一致,涉及四个能力因素:空间推理、感知、编码和利用操作。 空间工具占Sonnet工具呼叫的14.5%,占Opus的13.7%,在2,819个电话中有408个和1,332个电话中有183个。 Astra只发出7个工具呼叫,包括1个这样的工具,占14%. Astra很少依赖这些模块,这表明内在的认知和空间能力更强。 Sonnet和Opus反复重复使用这些模块,跨越任务,说明它们更多地依赖工具来弥补这些能力的局限性.

blocks.en: During cross-task transfer, agents also consult memory and skills from semantically similar tasks. In Organize Table, Opus combines a parameterized move tool from Pack Objects Into Box with a memory from Store Tools In Toolbox: “the PITCHED 30 deg grasp… reaches the +y half…” The tool supplies an operation, while the memory identifies a grasp orientation that extends its reach. This shows how a reusable procedure and knowledge of when it works can jointly support transfer ( Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: 在跨任务转移期间,代理商也从精密相似的任务中咨询内存和技能. 在Organization Table中,Opus将Pack Objects Into Box的参数化移动工具与工具箱中存储工具的内存组合在一起:“PITCHED 30 deg captal... 达到+y 半...” 该工具提供一种操作,而内存则识别出一种能扩展其覆盖范围的把握方向. 这表明可重复使用的程序和对何时工作的了解如何能联合支持转让(图9)。

blocks.en: The transfer traces suggest that performance gains depend on experience relevant to the target task’s bottleneck and the agent’s ability to assess its applicability from failure evidence. Semantic similarity helps identify candidate experience; failure evidence guides whether to reuse, adapt or discard it. The teaser illustrates this mechanism through the reuse of a closed-loop grasp-and-transfer routine from stacking blocks to covering blocks with a cup, and an insertion routine from key insertion to charger plugging.
blocks.zh: 转让的痕迹表明,业绩收益取决于与目标任务瓶颈有关的经验以及代理人根据失败证据评估其适用性的能力。 语义相似性有助于确定候选经验;故障证据指导是再利用、调整还是丢弃。 取笑器通过再利用从堆积区块到用杯子覆盖区块的闭锁式捕捉和转移常规,以及从密钥插入到充电插件的插入常规来说明这种机制.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The main comparison covers six model-plus-configuration systems, with one improvement chain per task. K0 repeats do not estimate variability across complete chains. First-success stopping records one success; reliable repeated execution needs a separate test. Budget and Improvement use conditional task sets that differ across systems. Astra’s outcomes differ between the main evaluation and the experiment without supplementary hints.
blocks.zh: 主要比较包括六个模型加配置系统,每个任务有一个改进链. K0 重复不估计整个链条的可变性。 第一成功停止记录一次成功;可靠的重复执行需要单独的测试. 预算和改进使用不同系统不同的有条件任务。 Astra的结果在主要评价与实验之间不尽相同,

blocks.en: The capability analysis relies on public benchmark scores whose evaluation settings differ from our runs, and it covers six systems without independent validation. Capability bottlenecks and gain-timing predictions therefore remain hypotheses to test. The ablation and frozen tests cover Astra and six tasks, while cross-task results are three first-run cases. These limits constrain the scope of the observed transfer and the mechanisms that can be inferred from it.
blocks.zh: 能力分析依赖于公共基准的得分,其评价环境与我们的运行不同,它涵盖6个系统,没有独立的验证。 因此,能力瓶颈和增益预测仍然是测试的假设。 衰竭和冷冻的测试涵盖了Astra和6项任务,而交叉任务的结果是3个首发病例. 这些限制限制了观察到的转让的范围和可从中推断的机制。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: PhysRSI-eval studies the origins, measurement, scaling and generalization of physical RSI under a fixed interaction budget. Capability associations motivate the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: the strengths needed to start well may differ from those needed to improve. The five-axis metric makes these outcomes explicit and shows that high scores, early gains and efficient interaction need not coincide. Cross-model prediction and early-round forecasting probe how these outcomes vary with capabilities and interaction budget. Workspace interventions support a role for retained experience and show that it can remain useful on new layouts and tasks. Physical RSI can thus involve both scene-specific adaptation and reusable improvement. Understanding it requires measuring how agents improve and examining what they retain.
blocks.zh: PhysRSI-eval在固定的相互作用预算下研究物理RSI的起源,测量,缩放和概括. 能力协会激发了物理 Barrel 假说:良好开始所需的优势可能不同于改进所需的优势。 五轴衡量标准明确了这些成果,表明高分、早期收益和高效互动不需要重合。 跨模型预测和早期预测探索这些结果如何因能力和互动预算而异。 工作空间干预支持保留经验的作用,并表明它仍有助于新的布局和任务。 因此,物理 RSI 既可以涉及特定场景的适应,也可以涉及可重复使用的改进. 理解它需要衡量代理人如何改进和检查他们保留了什么。

blocks.zh: 9 任务和协议细节

blocks.en: 10 Metric Definitions and Computation
blocks.zh: 10 计量定义和计算

blocks.en: Metrics are computed after averaging the task curves; in particular, Efficiency is a ratio of aggregate gains, not an average of task-wise ratios. The A3 threshold is the first integer Harness round reaching 90% of the observed peak gain, without interpolation. Budget charges each extra attempt once, supplements only failed reasoning-timeout rounds to their full step quota, and clips task savings at zero. Undefined denominators stay undefined. The summary in Figure 6 is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of A1–A5, multiplied by 100. It is neither radar polygon area nor a success probability.

blocks.en: 13 Ablation Details
blocks.zh: 13 细节

blocks.en: The six tasks are Push T, Plug in Charger, Deposit Coin, Play Xylophone, Pour by Language and Pour Liquid into Cup, with two chains per task and all six rounds run in every chain (no first-success stop). The first chain uses layouts 1–6 and the second layouts 7–12, one per round and in the same order for every condition; the Fixed condition keeps layout 1 or 7 throughout. All rounds are RoboDojo simulation episodes with native grading. Within a round, execution and revision share one conversation, and the next round starts a new conversation. Information from earlier rounds therefore reaches the agent only through the channels in Table 7 . Table 8 gives the per-round successes. Fixed has 22/36 late-round successes on its seen layouts and is descriptive rather than a matched unseen-layout comparison.
blocks.zh: 6项任务分别为Push T,插在充电器中,Depositive Coin,Play Xylophone,Pour by Language 和Pour Liquid into Cup,每个任务有两个链条,所有6轮都运行在每个链条中(没有第一个成功站). 第一连锁使用布局1–6,第二连锁使用布局7–12,每回合1个,每个条件的顺序相同;固定条件保持布局1或7全长. 所有回合都是 RoboDojo 模拟事件 具有本土分级。 在一轮内,执行和修订分享一次对话,下一轮开始新的对话. 因此,以往各轮提供的信息只能通过表7中的渠道传送给毒剂。 表8列出了每一轮的成功情况。 固定方案在其可见的布局上取得了22/36轮后期的成功,是描述性的,而不是与之相对应的不为人知的比较。
